title: Sorcerer With A Minigun (v30)
description: Darkhold Arena wave-survival RPG with enhanced enemy visuals: skeletons now have full bone rigs, demons have hunched muscular bodies with horns and claws, and brutes are massive troll-like monsters.
prompt:
. I want to improve how a few enemies look. Please edit the code directly and give me back the full updated file.

The basic "skeleton" enemy (in the drawEnemy function, the else if (enemy.type === 'skeleton') block) is just a filled rectangle body with a plain circle head — it looks like a chess pawn. Replace it with a proper bone/skeleton look: ribcage, spine, pelvis, jointed arms and legs, and a skull with a jaw, teeth, and glowing red eye sockets.

Important: the code ALREADY has a well-drawn, fully detailed skeleton rig elsewhere — look at the drawMinion function (this is what the player's summoned skeleton minion looks like). It has a spine, curved ribs, a pelvis, articulated bone arms/legs, and a detailed skull with jaw, teeth, and glowing red eyes. Reuse that same visual style/approach for the enemy skeleton so both skeletons look consistent, just simplified since the enemy doesn't need the full walk-cycle animation the minion has.

Also give the "demon" and "brute" enemies (same drawEnemy function) a visual pass so they don't look like a plain rectangle + circle either — make them fit a dark cave setting better (more hunched/monstrous posture, texture/detail, less blocky).
Keep the "ghost"/wraith enemy as is, it already looks fine.

Keep the rest of the game logic untouched — this should only be a visual/drawing change, not a gameplay change.
